conflict_reduction.rationale: A conflict-free strategy extension is enactable after lock-in, so failure of the matched strategy is explained by ordinary strategy conflict/rollback semantics rather than a general permeability boundary.

full_residual.rationale: PRE headroom holds, matched POST strategy enactment fails or reverts, generic execution intervention remains enactable, and even the conflict-free post-lock-in strategy extension fails or reverts. This residual warrants a fresh exact-reduction adjudication but does not itself pass ProblemGate.

generic_control_fail.rationale: The execution-level post-boundary control was not cleanly enacted, so the apparent strategy residual reduces to generic intervention/continuation failure.

generic_control_pass.rationale: Generic post-boundary intervention works; purchase the conflict-free strategy extension as the final reduction control.

initial.rationale: Headroom must be established before any post-lock-in arm is purchased.

post_enactable.rationale: The same strategy remains enactable after lock-in once initiation is externally supplied; the source missing-spontaneity-not-capability reduction is sufficient.

post_residual.rationale: A PRE-vs-POST strategy residual exists; test generic post-boundary intervention executability before buying the strategy-conflict control.

pre_headroom_fail.rationale: PRE_STRATEGY was not cleanly enacted, so post-lock-in failure would be uninterpretable.

pre_headroom_pass.rationale: PRE headroom passed; purchase only the matched post-lock-in strategy arm next.

next_action: Keep all paid DeepSeek execution disabled. If paid evidence is opened later, create an append-only authorization for PRE_STRATEGY only and apply this table after each completed arm before authorizing another.

positive_boundary.interpretation: This is only a residual worthy of fresh closest-work/exact-reduction adjudication; it is not a ProblemGate pass or paper authorization.
